permissions.other_body: {platform} support is best-effort and mostly untested.
permissions.untested: the Server Picker and the Live page. Both ask for your password.
permissions.broken: Please report it on GitHub. A fix is a big plus.
permissions.windows_body: You started Deadlock+ as administrator, so these features work without asking:
permissions.firewall: the Server Picker blocks the regions you pick by adding Windows Firewall rules named {rule}. Only administrators can do that.
permissions.monitor: live ping and loss for your match come from watching your network traffic, which is also admin-only.
permissions.frametimes: frame times come from watching how the game draws each frame, which is also admin-only.
permissions.admin_body: A few features change Windows settings that only an administrator can change. Deadlock+ asks Windows for permission when one of them is used.
permissions.always_note: One Windows prompt now, then never again on this Windows account.
permissions.later_note: Deadlock+ asks the first time a feature needs it.
permissions.always_on: Always allow is on. Windows won't ask again on this account.
permissions.always_on_hint: You can turn it off in Settings > Startup and background.

sharing.title: Help the Deadlock community?
sharing.intro: The Deadlock API is a free, community-run database behind many stat and replay sites. Sharing your matches helps keep it complete for every player.
sharing.consent: If you agree, Deadlock+ sends what's needed to load your matches' details and replays, plus the match IDs and your Steam ID. Nothing else leaves your computer.
sharing.optional: Optional. You can change this any time in Settings.
sharing.telemetry_body: Deadlock+ also sends anonymous usage counts and error reports, so we know how many people use it and what breaks. It sends the app version, your system, which pages you open, when you open the Discord invite, when an update is offered or started, and error details. It uses a random ID and never sends paths, names, Steam IDs, IP addresses or match data.
sharing.telemetry_toggle: Share anonymous usage data and error reports
sharing.skipped: Skip this and sharing stays off until you decide in Settings.

extras.title: Optional extras
extras.intro: All off by default. You can change any of them later.
extras.autostart_note: Launches Deadlock+ when you sign in.
extras.tray_note: Closing the window hides it instead of quitting.
extras.alerts_note: A notification when a new patch note or announcement is posted.
extras.maintenance_note: A notification before the usual weekly maintenance.
extras.gc_recovery_note: Fills in matches the Deadlock API is missing. Uses the Steam login saved on this PC.
extras.footer: Alerts and reminders only fire while the app runs, so they pair well with the tray option.
extras.presence_note: Shows your hero, mode, rank and match timer on your Discord profile.
